questions.question: In JSX, which attribute holds classes?
questions.explanation: class is a reserved word in JavaScript. See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: What does clsx do?
options: Joins class names and skips falsy values
questions.explanation: clsx("p-2", isActive && "bg-sky-50"). See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: What does tailwind-merge add on top of clsx?
options: It removes earlier classes that conflict with later ones
questions.explanation: twMerge("px-2", "px-6") → "px-6". See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: When does a component need tailwind-merge?
options: When it accepts className (or other class props) that may override its own classes
questions.explanation: Otherwise clsx is enough. See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: Which plugins does a Vite + React + Tailwind config list?
questions.explanation: Both plugins side by side. See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: Why style tabs with aria-selected: instead of computing classes from state?
options: The accessibility attribute doubles as the styling hook, and the classes stay static
questions.explanation: State in attributes, styles in variants.

questions.question: twMerge("text-brand", "text-display") drops text-brand in a project with custom theme values. Why?
options: tailwind-merge doesn't read your CSS theme, so it can't tell a colour from a size; configure it with extendTailwindMerge
questions.explanation: Teach it your custom scale names. See Appendix C, Tailwind with React Components.

questions.question: Which libraries formalise variant lookups for components?
questions.explanation: Typed variants, compound variants and defaults.
